about: Pricing and placing: subtotal, delivery fee and the free-delivery threshold (judged on subtotal − discount once an offer applies), the ₹1 floor (discount ≤ subtotal − 100), the per-line discount split, COD rules, stock, caps (10 lines per order, 2 unpaid online orders), ORDER_TOO_LARGE, and what placeOrder writes. Ported from supabase/tests/offers.test.sql (pricing parts), supabase/tests/orders.test.sql (place_order parts) and scripts/api_e2e.py money_checks / offers_checks / caps_checks, with the semantics of private.price_lines (20261030000260_best_offer.sql) and public.place_order (20261030000000_offers.sql). placeOrder checks in this order: CART_EMPTY, CART_LIMIT, ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND, PENDING_LIMIT (online only), OUT_OF_STOCK, the coupon error, ORDER_TOO_LARGE, COD_UNAVAILABLE. Variants v1-v3 are offers.test.sql's, v5-v9 orders.test.sql's (T-CHEAP, T-PRICEY, T-OFF, T-EMPTY, T-RETIRED), va..vretired and l01..l11 api_e2e.py's; cases from api_e2e.py override settings/store with its free-delivery minimum of 100000. Conventions beyond vector-format.md: a doc in "given" replaces the world doc of the same path whole (every given doc is written in full). A field expected as null matches null or absent. orders items[] are listed in variant-id order; match them by id. "$orderId" / "$id" = the id the call returned. A "then" key ending in "/*" means the one doc in that collection (the case starts with none there); "<collection>/*": null means the call creates none. Where an expected value was not asserted by the SQL test but re-derived from the SQL code (price_lines, evaluate_promotion, offer_open, reward_referral, apply_referral_code), the case "about" says "derived".

notExpressed.why: Direct-insert CHECK constraints (total = subtotal + fee − discount, discount ≤ subtotal − 100, discount ≥ 0, line discount ≤ line total, offers.test.sql:243-250). Firebase has no client order writes; the same rules are assertOrderTotals() before every order write, exercised by every placeOrder vector here.

An invariant over every order in the database, not one call (also api_e2e.py audit_numbers). Consumers should assert Σ items[].discountPaise = discountPaise, Σ unitPricePaise × qty = subtotalPaise, totalPaise = subtotalPaise + deliveryFeePaise − discountPaise and 1 ≤ qty ≤ 5 after every placeOrder case.
Pattern ^SM[0-9]{6}$; the format has no pattern matcher and the counters/orders numbering start is not fixed by the SQL test.
"Exactly these keys" cannot be said with a deep-partial match; the case lists the values only. Firebase adds stateCode (§3), so the key set changes anyway.
Rules check (clients never write variants), ported with the rules tests.
Cart qty 1..5 and the 20-line cart cap (api_e2e.py caps_checks "a 21st cart line") are Rules checks on carts/{uid} writes, not callable calls.
Variant price validation belongs to saveProduct, not pricing.
Concurrency (also the 25 add-to-cart races): needs parallel callers against the emulator, not data. The sequential effect is the OUT_OF_STOCK cases.
Cancel/expiry restock and their timeline notes are order state-machine rules, outside this pricing file.
PostgREST signature check (PGRST202). The Firebase equivalent is the zod input schema; the error for an unknown input key is not fixed by the SQL.
Razorpay create-payment and webhook amount checks: dropped (decision D4).
